chunks: 4910 - Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said:
A man's family are his captives. So whoever Allah blesses with a blessing, let him expand his provision upon his captives. If he does not do so, that blessing is close to being taken away.

key_terms.أُسَرَاؤُهُ: those bound to him and reliant upon him, expressing responsibility toward them
key_terms.تَزُولَ: to depart, vanish, or be removed
key_terms.عِيَالُ: dependents and family members under a person's care
key_terms.فَلْيُوَسِّعْ: let him be expansive and generous in spending
key_terms.نِعْمَةً: a divine blessing or favor, especially material provision

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام teach about providing generously for one's family?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a man bears a serious responsibility toward those dependent on him in his household. When Allah grants someone provision and blessing, he should show generosity to his family, for neglecting them may lead to the loss of that blessing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4910 - Imam Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon them) said:

"A man's family are his captives. So, whoever Allah (swt) blesses with a blessing, let him expand (his provision) upon his captives (family). If he does not, that blessing is close to being taken away."
